description: Sixteen evenly spaced values between a start and an end voltage, each passed through a sine, then offset, scaled and taken modulo a chosen number, all sent out as one polyphonic cable

params.text: Sets the voltage the sixteen evenly spaced values begin at, over -10V to 10V
Sets the voltage the sixteen evenly spaced values end at, over -10V to 10V
Multiplies each of the sixteen values before the sine is taken, over -10 to 10, which sets how many cycles of the sine the span covers
Adds a constant to each sine result before it is scaled, over -10 to 10
Multiplies each offset sine result, over -10 to 10; at exactly 0 the sixteen values are never calculated and the output carries undefined data
Sets the number each value is taken modulo, over 0 to 10; a setting of 0 is treated as 0.001

inputs.text: Replaces the start knob with this voltage, so the knob does nothing while a cable is patched here and a cable resting at 0V sets the start to 0V
Replaces the end knob with this voltage, so the knob does nothing while a cable is patched here and a cable resting at 0V sets the end to 0V
Replaces the freq mult knob; a polyphonic cable gives each of the sixteen values its own multiplier, a monophonic one is used for all sixteen
Replaces the offset knob with this voltage, so the knob does nothing while a cable is patched here
Replaces the scale knob with this voltage; a cable resting at 0V leaves the output undefined
Replaces the modulus knob; a polyphonic cable gives each of the sixteen values its own modulus, a monophonic one is used for all sixteen

outputs.text: The sixteen calculated values, always sent as sixteen polyphonic channels

notes: Every input replaces its knob rather than adding to it, so patching a cable leaves that knob doing nothing until the cable is pulled.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the start knob.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the end knob.
inputs.2:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the freq mult knob.
inputs.3:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the offset knob.
inputs.4:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the scale knob.
inputs.5:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the modulus knob.
